title: Punjab anti-drug activist Parminder Singh Jhota shot dead in Mansa - Moneycontrol.com
full_text:
Anti-drug activist Parminder Singh Jhota was shot dead by unidentified assailants in Punjab’s Mansa on Tuesday morning. Two others accompanying him were seriously injured in the attack, according to local media reports in Punjab.
A live video was streamed on Jhota’s Facebook page, in which bullets were fired. Jhota and his companions were seen arguing with a medical store owner in Mansa area over drugs in the video.
According to Amar Ujala, the assailants opened fire at Jhota at close range. He sustained multiple bullet injuries and collapsed at the scene. The incident has triggered outrage in Mansa and adjoining parts of the Malwa region.
Video: Facebook Live captures heated exchange before shooting
People present at the scene, the report said, rushed Jhota and the two injured men to the Mansa Civil Hospital for treatment. Doctors declared Jhota dead on arrival, while the other two men were admitted to the emergency ward with serious injuries.
Jhota had been campaigning against the sale and distribution of drugs, including chitta (heroin) and intoxicating pills allegedly sold illegally through medical stores, in Mansa and other parts of Punjab.
As part of his campaign, he and his team would confront establishments suspected of supplying drugs to young people, record the encounters and livestream them on social media.
Police launch investigation, security tightened
Senior Punjab Police officers, according to Amar Ujala, accompanied by a large contingent of personnel, reached the spot after receiving information about the killing. The area was cordoned off, and security was tightened across the district.
Police have set up checkpoints at district entry and exit points and are examining CCTV footage from nearby areas to identify the attackers and establish their escape route, the report said.

title: Punjab murder: Mansa activist Jhota had paraded his alleged killer with shoe garland in 2023 - Moneycontrol.com
full_text:
Anti-drug activist Parvinder Singh, popularly known as Jhota, was shot dead at a drug store in Mansa on Tuesday. The man now accused of the killing is Ashwani Kumar, whom Jhota had paraded through a local market in 2023, The Tribune reported.
Mansa SSP Vaibhav Chaudhary was cited as saying that the incident as tragic and called the deceased a social worker. He assured that the accused would be arrested within 24 hours and said that whether the weapon used was legal or illegal was under investigation, the report said.
Jhota’s supporters gathered in large numbers at the Civil Hospital and raised slogans against the police, the report noted. A large contingent of police personnel was deployed to maintain law and order. The supporters later began a protest at Bara Hatta Chowk in Mansa.
Jhota’s father said the family would not cremate the body until justice was delivered. He demanded the immediate dismissal of the Punjab Government and urged the Centre, Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah to take note of the situation in the state, as per the report. Anti-drug activists, he said, were being shot dead in the open.
The 2023 incident has resurfaced after the killing, according to the report. A purported video from July 2023 shows Jhota and his supporters catching a man who was allegedly selling banned capsules. They followed him to a shop from where he was reportedly procuring the drugs, the report added.
Jhota and his supporters claimed to have found banned drugs at the shop. They then paraded its owner, Ashwani Kumar, through the market with a garland of shoes around his neck, as per the report.
Ashwani was subsequently taken to the police station, where Jhota lodged a complaint against him. An FIR was registered against Ashwani on the basis of that complaint, the report said. However, after videos of the incident circulated on social media, the police also booked Jhota for allegedly taking the law into his own hands.

title: Who was Parvinder Singh Jhota? Anti-drug activist shot dead while confronting Punjab chemist on Facebook... - Moneycontrol.com
full_text:
An anti-drug activist was shot dead on Tuesday after he confronted the owner of a medical store over the alleged sale of drugs in Punjab's Mansa district.
The entire incident was captured during a live Facebook session, with the video quickly spreading across social media.
The victim, identified as Parvinder Singh Jhota, was known for campaigning against drug abuse and exposing the alleged illegal sale of addictive substances through some chemist shops in Mansa and nearby areas.
Who was Parvinder Singh Jhota?
Jhota had built a strong following on social media, with more than 24,000 followers on Facebook. His videos, in which he confronted people over the alleged sale of drugs, were widely shared online.
According to a report by NDTV, he first came into the spotlight in 2023 after a dispute with another medical store owner.
Following that incident, police registered cases against Jhota and some of his associates on charges including assault, trespass and rioting.
He was arrested in July 2023 and remained in jail for about two months before being released, the report added.
What happened at the shop?
In the nearly five-minute video, Jhota is seen standing outside the medical store with an elderly man, claiming that the man had purchased drugs from the shop.
He repeatedly questioned the shop owner and demanded that he show the CCTV footage to prove his claims.
A heated argument followed between the two. The shop owner, who was seen holding a pistol, asked the elderly man whether he had bought drugs from the store. Jhota replied, "Yes, we have the recording."
During the confrontation, Jhota repeatedly challenged the shop owner, saying, "Maar mujhe, maar mujhe (kill me, kill me)." He also questioned why the man was carrying a pistol and asked his associates to call the police and gather more people at the spot.
The argument continued for around four minutes before the shop owner allegedly opened fire. Jhota was shot and died at the scene.
